text:
Ali (PM): Quick sync on Dedicated roadmap priorities — we're trying to land an MVP for reserved pools + burst behavior by EOW. Need alignment on: 1) must-have launch KPIs, 2) minimal autoscale fallback rules, 3) what customer asks get cut if scope hits.

Michael (Eng-Platform): Can we list concrete KPIs? My proposal: P95 latency <= 200ms for standard-tenants, burst spike absorb w/o failed requests for up to 5m, and committed throughput accuracy +/-10%. Also need telemetry: per-tenant headroom utilization + missing allocation alerts.

Ali (PM): Good. Add customer onboarding time (time from commit -> first successful low-latency serve) as a KPI. Jen, anything from CS customers blocking GA?

Jen (Customer Success): Yes — two pilot customers care about predictable burst guarantees and a simple SLA clause. They want a fallback model if reserved pool is saturated (e.g., automatic best-effort degrade to smaller model rather than error). If we can promise degrade behavior in contract, that helps them sign.

Dan (Eng-SRE): Fallback to smaller model is feasible but we need a deterministic routing policy. Options: 1) route to pre-warmed micro-pool (costly), 2) best-effort queue up to Xms, 3) auto-failover to quantized variant. For MVP I'd push for option 3 + short queue window (100ms) so p95 latency holds.

Sam (Product Ops): Customer asks prioritization: recommend we categorize asks into: MUST (contract/backstop behavior, core telemetry, commit accuracy), SHOULD (self-serve quota visibility, per-tenant burst dashboard), NICE-TO-HAVE (fine-grained per-route admission controls). We can push SHOULD to next milestone.

Ali (PM): Sounds right. Need concrete gating for GA: MUST items done, 3 pilot customers signed on, automated rollback policy in console, and e2e chaos test (preemption + region failover).

Michael (Eng-Platform): For autoscale policy, proposing a minimal config that ops can ship for MVP. Sample (very small) config we tested in staging:```json
{
  "policy_name": "mvp-autoscale",
  "scale_up_threshold": 0.8,
  "scale_down_threshold": 0.35,
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 12,
  "burst_window_seconds": 300,
  "fallback": {
    "on_saturation": "route_to_quantized",
    "max_queue_ms": 100
  }
}
```This gives predictable headroom and an explicit fallback default.

Dan (Eng-SRE): +1 to those defaults. Note: max_replicas should be tied to tenant commitment; need a mapping table. Also require a metric: "recent_burst_count" with windowed cardinality for alerting.

Jen (Customer Success): If we default fallback to quantized variant, make sure we communicate model-quality delta to customers and include opt-out. One pilot asked for a visible degradation banner in Console when fallback is active.

Sam (Product Ops): Agree on banner. Also add a short-run rollout plan: canary 5% traffic from pilot tenants -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality-regression alerts (eval-based).

Ali (PM): OK next steps: Michael/Dan create a PR with the autoscale defaults + mapping doc by Thu. Sam + Jen to draft customer-facing fallback language for contracts and console by Thu. I'll pull in legal if needed. Ops-bot, can you create a follow-up task?

ops-bot: Task created: PROD-1427 "MVP reserved pools fallback + autoscale defaults" assigned to Michael, Dan, Sam. Due 1711190000. :white_check_mark:

Michael (Eng-Platform): One more technical note — we should add a per-tenant token-bucket for burst credits and a short-lived carryover policy (max 10% carryover). That helps us reason about burst economics.

Ali (PM): Good call. Add to PR. If we hit scope issues we will cut: NICE-TO-HAVE items, per-route admission controls, and extended retention for telemetry. Leave MUST/SHOULD.

Jen (Customer Success): I'll update pilots — they prefer degrade-to-smaller-model over queueing. Will surface any contractual redlines ASAP.

Dan (Eng-SRE): I'll add the alert rules and chaos test checklist to the PR. Also logging: ensure we surface fallback reason in request traces (tag: fallback.reason).

Ali (PM): Thanks all. Quick poll — react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the MVP gating plan, :eyes: if you want to discuss further.

Michael (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup: 

Jen (Customer Success): :thumbsup:  

Dan (Eng-SRE): :eyes: I'll sync with Michael on replica mapping, small question about prewarm budget.

Sam (Product Ops): :thumbsup:

Ali (PM): Noted. We'll have a 15m standup tomorrow 10:00 to iron out Dan's question and confirm PR owners.
